r.notes: This is the FIRST  ( and only) Koala we have EVER seen on our 40 acres. We have lived here 20 years now. Rural acreage mostly cleared already with some patches lightly forested.  Surrounded by other rural blocks ( mostly cleared). We are near Mt Neurum and D’Aguilar National Park. Koala was seen MOVING on GROUND ( for 40 metres) and then went up ( ?Grey Gum ) tree . Still asleep there this afternoon.  The only other Koala we have seen in the area is one we rescued, injured on road near Stanley River, towards Woodford. Seen  3 echidnas ( >10 years ago) . Have wallabies, mountain possums, squirrel gliders, phascogales, bandicoots, few water dragons, one frilled neck lizard, few goannas, few pythons, few red-bellied blacks, few brown snakes, plenty geckos, green tree fogs ( and others reported on Frog ID), plenty tree snakes, parrots = king, Rainbow l., yellow-headed, scaly br, galahs. Channel- billed c., little grebes, 3  occasional dingoes ( and foxes), 2 brush turkeys.  and more ! Would like to record more in future. I have degree in Zoology. Unfortunately I worked in healthcare ( by default!)
